**Scope correction for the in-flight dev — recorded 2026-10-31T02:58Z.** The card body was amended after claim 6537994813; please re-read it before the next push.

- On an item of a **read-only package** the five tools are **read-only**: ⛔ no rollback, no source save, no reset/delete there — each writes a package-less overlay row, a path this epic closes. Rollback and source save only on items of the **writable** package open in Studio.
- ADR-0146 on `main` predates the re-plan: its D2 (in-place overlay editing, *Reset to package default*), D3 (`<base>.customize`) and Phase 2 are superseded by epic #28236 and rewritten in #28237 — ⛔ not implemented here. D1 still governs this card.
- Instruction — the maintainer, in a direct desktop session, verbatim: 「issue 你要先改，避免车道做错、」; the rulings behind it: 「我建议先等包级覆盖开发完，再考虑这个界面的修改」 · 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」.
